Where scenarios come from

Source: R/scenario.R
from_vignettes.Rd

  • from_vignettes(): the vignettes of the baseline, read from the vignettes/ folder of its source tarball. Each R chunk becomes a step that is run as in the vignette, with the chunk's fig.width and fig.height (or fig.dim, or the defaults the vignette sets with knitr::opts_chunk$set() or its output format) for plots. Chunks with eval = FALSE are listed as not run; an eval option that is an expression is evaluated in the vignette's environment when the chunk is reached. Every visible value is printed and its numbers collected, as is every object a chunk assigns at top level.

  • from_examples(): the examples on the baseline's help pages, read from the man/ folder of its source tarball as R CMD check reads them (tools::Rd2ex()). Each help page with examples is a scenario (ex_<page>) and each top-level expression a step. Code in \donttest{} is run, as R CMD check --as-cran runs it; code in \dontrun{} is not, and the scenario notes it. Examples run from the run's own folder.

  • scenario_file(): an R file that creates scenarios with scenario() and step(). Every scenario the file creates is used, in the order created.

Usage

from_vignettes(which = NULL, time = TRUE, values = TRUE)

from_examples(which = NULL, time = FALSE, values = TRUE)

scenario_file(path)

Arguments

which

Vignette file names, or help-page file names for from_examples() (without extension), to use; NULL uses all.

time

Time each chunk (each example expression) with repeats.

values

Collect numbers and element names from each chunk (each example expression).

path

Path to a scenario file.

Value

An object of class pkgdossier_scenario_source.

Details

Vignettes that read stored results (readRDS(), load(), cache = TRUE) are run as they are and flagged in the report: their numbers do not test the computation, so a scenario file is the better source for them.

Examples

from_vignettes()
#> <pkgdossier scenario source> baseline vignettes
from_examples(which = c("fit_model", "plot_model"))
#> <pkgdossier scenario source> baseline help-page examples (fit_model, plot_model)
scenario_file("dev/dossier/scenarios.R")
#> <pkgdossier scenario source> scenario file dev/dossier/scenarios.R
